target_customer: Direct to consumer brands on Shopify that sell subscriptions, clubs and memberships
problem: Merchants found existing subscription apps limiting, with checkout friction and weak bundling. The founder cites her sister's DTC beauty brand as the trigger.
business_model: B2B SaaS monthly subscription for a Shopify app, reportedly $299 per month plus a per order fee

founders.name: Emily Yuhas
founders.background_notes: YC page: product leader who built Eventbrite checkout, Redfin tour scheduling and worked on Xbox One. Company about page lists Redfin, Eventbrite and Microsoft.

founders.name: Brian Singer
founders.background_notes: Awtomic about page: full-stack engineer with over a decade of experience; joined Eventbrite through its acquisition of nvite and led teams in Madrid on site-building tools and online events.

founders.name: Adrian Andrade
founders.background_notes: Awtomic about page: led design teams at early stage startups and at Eventbrite and Expedia Group, focused on checkout and growth.

competitors.name: Recharge
competitors.what: Incumbent Shopify subscription app that sent customers to its own checkout
competitors.traction_then: Operated almost without competition before Shopify's Oct 2020 subscriptions API, per a trade guide

competitors.name: Bold Subscriptions
competitors.what: Shopify subscription app for basic plans

technical_complexity.rationale: A Shopify app with billing logic is standard engineering. Native checkout integration and recurring payments added moderate difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: Merchants reconnect subscriber data when switching, but Shopify's new subscriptions API in Oct 2020 let many rivals build similar apps.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Shopify opened subscription APIs in Oct 2020, inviting competitors. No acquisition of Awtomic found.

market_need_then: Pandemic era DTC growth increased demand for subscriptions. Merchant reviews on the Shopify app store describe leaving Recharge over checkout friction.

identity.voice_and_tone: Founder led and personal support; reviews repeatedly name Emily

branding.brand_signature: Dollar Shave Club as a platform tagline
branding.community_and_virality: Shopify app listing shows a 5.0 rating from 34 reviews that praise founder support.

brand_strength.rationale: Mostly an app store brand with strong reviews but no press about the brand. The respelled name may cause confusion, and CB Insights lists the company as Bundle Payments.

outcome_analysis: Awtomic is a small Shopify subscriptions app led by a solo founder that is still active with about 11 people. No institutional round was found, only an aggregator claim of a $500K note. It competes with Recharge and Bold in a crowded market after Shopify's 2020 API change. Public evidence of traction is limited to app store reviews, so no success or failure story can be asserted.
notes: CB Insights reports a $500K convertible note from Y Combinator and Lombardstreet Ventures; single aggregator, so unverified and not recorded as a round. CB Insights also lists the company as Bundle Payments, and the YC page bio mentions Bundle; the rename date and reason are not sourced. awtomic.com could not be fetched because the safety check was rate limited, so the site is unconfirmed; the about page appeared only via search snippets. Competitor source is an undated trade guide that cites the Oct 2020 Shopify API. Name origin not found. Outcome search found no acquisition or shutdown. Update: the awtomic.com about page was opened and names Brian Singer (CTO) and Adrian Andrade (CDO) beside Emily Yuhas; it lists no competitors. The about page does not say they are co-founders in those words, so they are recorded as founding team members by title. Competitor sourcing: the ecommercefastlane guide is undated; a search for a source dated near 2020-08 found only 2021 or later pages (the Shopify community thread on Recharge, PayWhirl and Bold starts 2021-01-23), so no dated source was found and source_date stays null. Completeness pass: the $500K convertible note is recorded from a single database (CB Insights); date null. The CB Insights Bundle Payments page lists a seed VC round with only Lombardstreet Ventures and no amount, which may be the same event or another.
